name: Cost summary
description: Get the sum of recorded cost estimates and artifact counts, for one session or all sessions. Estimates from dated published rates and caller-supplied usage, not provider invoices. Unpriced records are excluded from totals. See docs/billing.md; return the warning to the user.

warning.description: Display this pricing and calculation warning to the user.

unpricedCount.description: Records excluded because no cost was computed. Null for legacy sessions with unknown coverage.
